_readme: Static walkable-tile grid for the starting house, built from the BG tilemap (LCDC/SCY/SCX read at 0x9800, room is fully on-screen with SCX=SCY=0). Cell size is 16px (2x2 BG tiles), matching move_tiles's measured ~14px step. Base classification: a cell is walkable only if all 4 underlying 8px BG tiles are in the known-floor set (0x18/19/1a/1b, 0x10/11/12/13, 0x00/01/02/03/7f) -- everything else defaults to blocked. Cells (2,4), (3,5) and (4,4) were reclassified to blocked after 3 independent live runs consistently confirmed them impassable (the bed/table corridor's true collision is narrower than the tile-ID classification predicts). NOTE: for actual navigation in this room, prefer Navigator.reach_pixel (continuous pixel tracking, no grid rounding) over Navigator.reach (cell-based BFS) -- see ZELDA_BACKLOG.md's 'Navigator — pixel-greedy fallback succeeded' section. This grid is kept for coarse route reference and for rooms with more open floor where cell rounding isn't an issue.
